title: Deterministic context slice ranking
summary: Make context-slice retrieval strictly token-bounded, intent-aware, precision-ranked, explicitly explainable, and deterministic without external services.
reason: The baseline AI-token-cleanup query exceeded its requested budget and elevated incidental cleanup/source/token matches from unrelated WebView, API, PowerShell, network, release, and sample-library domains over direct generated-context tooling.
behavior_before: Capsules could exceed the requested estimate by a tolerance, generic request vocabulary counted as domain evidence, every layer could be force-selected, two-hop relationships spread weak matches, intent classification covered only a few coarse cases, and omissions had only a count.
behavior_after: Capsules fit the exact requested estimate, normalize identifiers deterministically, separate stop words and low-information terms, strongly prefer exact paths/symbols/phrases/feature anchors, penalize intent mismatches, avoid forced unrelated layers, and report selected plus aggregated omission reasons.

rollback_plan: Revert only the context ranking/normalization changes, focused tests, regenerated project-index outputs and summaries, then rerun the generated-context tools. Preserve unrelated MCP, audit, release, and application worktree changes.
